es.title: Samario
es.extract: El samario es un elemento químico de símbolo Sm y número atómico 62. Presenta una estructura cristalina romboedral, una masa atómica de 150,35 y una densidad de 7,35 g/cm³.
es.description: elemento químico de la tabla periódica, con símbolo Sm y número atómico 62

en.title: Samarium
en.extract: Samarium is a chemical element; it has symbol Sm and atomic number 62. It is a moderately hard silvery metal that slowly oxidizes in air. Being a typical member of the lanthanide series, samarium usually has the oxidation state +3. Compounds of samarium(II) are also known, most notably the monoxide SmO, monochalcogenides SmS, SmSe and SmTe, as well as samarium(II) iodide.
